not_latest_version: Current author documentation is 6.0.1; no latest-version or variant-prior-weight equivalence is granted.
inputs: One combined rectangular TSV File, literal per-trait SNP columns and explicit beta/varbeta or pvalue/MAF mappings
outputs: port 0: coloc_abf.RDS (r_rds), untouched complete author result
official_meaning: H0 neither trait, H1 only trait 1, H2 only trait 2, H3 distinct variants, H4 shared variant; SNP.PP.H4 is conditional on H4, not marginal probability or FDR.

scoped_author_proof.independent_reference: Fresh SHA-locked CRAN source installed separately; datasets constructed as independent typed R literals; entire returned RDS identical including every intermediate SNP field, priors, row IDs, types and attributes.

isolated_DAG_proof.scope: Sealed generic runner/container-plugin and immutable SDK, not resident daemon or whole current engine

supported_routes: explicit and zero priors, author prior adjustment, null signal and single-SNP H3=0
repairs: Restore canonical original ABF alongside signal-aware coloc_susie in unified family
Preserve literal identifiers and reject ambiguous headers, ragged rows or absent mappings
Reject non-finite inputs and invalid variances/scales/sample sizes/frequencies/priors
Refuse existing/aliased outputs and non-finite returned inference
Correct two defects introduced during repair: Sys.readlink NA guard and R partial $s matching to snp; failed attempts retained
remaining: Latest 6.x and full author API (variant-specific prior weights, positions, effect-prior override etc.) are not certified
